feature: ADR-0085 Linux host owned Session and terminal classification

linux.new_custom_main_harness: three no-input child modes: complete/uncertain/missing reports; injected stop event only

abi: No FFI/native ABI change; ADR-0084 oracle not rerun in this slice.
dependencies: Only existing local keyweave-linux added as Linux-specific host dependency; no registry additions.

windows.scope: Linux-only controller and harness; earlier native/portable pending checks unchanged after automatic approval quota failure

limitations: Controller requires trusted controlled worker and same explicit time domain as spawn; caller must continue driving same Supervisor independently of worker.
Actual native signal/clock/wait pump, run-linux CLI and cold host startup composition remain incomplete.
Signal receipt and requested Stop do not prove delivery or exit; report produced only after Supervisor authoritative actual exit.
Terminal recovery_confirmed classifies worker-reported owner/recovery facts, not physical acceptance or global keyboard recovery.
Synthetic KWLT facts from no-input fixture prove transport/classification only. Injected timestamps do not test real lease scheduling.
No foreground-group signals, actual Ctrl+C, VT/evdev/uinput, Hook/SendInput or driver operation.
Full original cross-platform objective remains incomplete.
